Beak.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* piercing damage.

Bite.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC *DC* Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Claws.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* slashing damage.

Charge.Description: If the *NAME* moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and then hits it with a *ATTACK_NAME* attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra *DICE* slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC *DC* Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Gore.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* piercing damage.

Hidden.Description: The *NAME* has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks when remaining motionless

Hooves.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* bludgeoning damage.

Horns.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* piercing damage.

Keen Hearing.Description: The *NAME* has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

Keen Hearing and Sight.Description: The *NAME* has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

Keen Hearing and Smell.Description: The *NAME* has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

Keen Sight and Smell.Description: The *NAME* has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

Keen Smell.Description: The *NAME* has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Owlbear.NAME: Owlbear
Owlbear.DESC: one with its beak and one with its claws.

Pack Tactics.Description: The *NAME* has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the *NAME*'s allies is within 5 ft. of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

Relentless.Description: If the *NAME* takes *DAMAGE_TAKEN* damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

Small Creature.Description: The *NAME* has Armour Class increases to *AC* when target is at least *DISTANCE* ft. away

Silent Flight.Description: The *NAME* makes no sound when flying

Talons.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: (*DICE*) slashing damage.

Tusk.Description: Melee Weapon Attack: +*HIT* to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: *DICE* + *DICE_MOD* slashing damage.
